File 22899-T1

TYPE 1 ZONING MAP AMENDMENT
Substitute Narrative
2409-11 West Congress Parkway
RT-3.5 District to B2-3 District (Type 1)

4Corners, LLC is the “Applicant” for a Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment for the subject property located at 2409-11
West Congress Parkway from the RT-3.5 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District to the B2-3
Neighborhood Mixed-Use District in order to divide the existing improved zoning lot into two zoning lots and
construct a new multi-unit residential development.

The subject property is bounded by West Congress Parkway on the north, an alley on the south, and vacant property
on the west. To the east, the subject property is abutted by the property commonly known as 2401-07 West
Congress Parkway, which is currently improved with a 4-story institutional building that is currently vacant. The
adjacent property and the subject property are currently a single improved zoning lot. The Applicant proposes to
divide the existing zoning {ot into two zoning lots and develop each for residential use. The subject property will be
one of the new zoning lots.

The subject property contains approximately 15,456 square feet of site area and is improved with a 2-story building,
a 2-story vacant addition to the adjacent building to the east, and a surface parking lot. The subject property is a
transit-served location based on its proximity to the Western Avenue CTA Blue Line station entrance and the
Western Avenue bus line corridor. The Applicant plans to redevelop the site with a 5-story multi-unit residential
building measuring approximately 58 feet 5 inches in height and containing 58 dwelling units, 25 vehicular parking
spaces, 38 bicycle parking spaces, and no commercial space. The overall FAR will be 3.5. The Applicant seeks all
relief necessary, as allowed by the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, for the attached plans.

Floor Area Ratio

Lot Area: 15,456 square feet
FAR: 3.5*
Number of Residential Units
Dwelling Units: 38
Efficiency Units: 20
Total Units: 58

Density (Lot Area Per Unit): 266.5 square feet*

Parking and Loading

Vehicular Parking: 25 spaces

Bicycle Parking: 38 spaces

Loading: 0 spaces**
Setbacks

Front (North): 4 feet 9 inches**

Rear (South): 3 feet**

Side (East): 3 feet

Side (West): 3 feet**
Building Height: 58 feet 5 inches

* The property is a transit-served location due to its proximity within 2,640 feet from the Western Avenue CTA Biue
Line station entrance and within 1,320 feet from the Western Avene CTA bus line corridor roadway segment. The
Applicant seeks an MLA reduction and a FAR increase to 3.5.

** Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, as part of this Type 1 Zoning Map
Amendment, the Applicant seeks variations: (1) to reduce the required off-street loading from one space to zero
spaces; (2) to reduce the required front yard setback for property that abuts R-zoned property with lot frontage on
the same street from 15 feet to 4 feet 9 inches; (3) to reduce the minimum required rear setback for floors containing
